input.rationale: Rear-end collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and personal injury (whiplash and sprained wrist) is a clear motor-vehicle damage claim under auto coverage.
Vehicle is totaled and policyholder has sustained injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist); totaled vehicles and injury claims automatically trigger high severity.

input.claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15am yesterday at a red light by a vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph.
